description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing The Fantastic Four, adding {C}{C}.
When The Fantastic Four dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return The Fantastic Four from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When The Fantastic Four enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
